title: CENTCOM bottleneck on UAP information

tellings.quote: Central Command has a bottleneck to UAP information before it gets to the people

plain: US Central Command, the military command that runs American forces in the Middle East, holds back information about UAP, the official term for UFOs, before it reaches the public. That is what the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell tells Michels, from reporting he did with the journalist George Knapp; he calls it "a bottleneck." If true, it would mean military records of these sightings get held up at that command.
